answer: Require each agent identity to anchor itself to one deployed physical sensor, such as an air-quality station, that streams signed, location-bound readings every epoch. Readings from nearby stations cross-check each other, so a single device cannot serve two identities: its measurements form one vertex in a verification graph, and a forged duplicate creates a ripple of mismatches with its neighbours. A Sybil operator who wants a hundred identities must buy, install and maintain a hundred sensors at a hundred sites, an island of hardware per identity, while an honest agent pays for just one.
